title: Hikari Organic White Miso Paste 1kg
description_en: Hikari Miso's organic shiro (white) miso is aged for 3 months in traditional cedar barrels. The shortest fermentation produces a mild, sweet flavor profile perfect for miso soup, marinades, and salad dressings. USDA Organic certified.
description_ja: ひかり味噌の有機白味噌。杉樽で3ヶ月熟成させた短期発酵ならではの甘くマイルドな味わい。みそ汁・漬けタレ・ドレッシングに。米国農務省有機認証取得。
